messages:
Alex R: PR #4128 ready for review — mainly restructuring the auth page and adding SDK snippets for rust + node. CI passed locally for me but Netlify preview is queued.
Tess: thanks Alex! i'll take a look after lunch. any known preview flakiness? :thinking_face:
Alex R: yeah netlify is 30+ builds in queue right now. sometimes the preview artifacts don't include the font assets; seen a missing /assets/fonts/* 404 in a past run.
Devon: re: fonts — that usually indicates the mkdocs build ran while the artifact sharder was reusing an old cache. If the preview looks busted, try `mkdocs build -d site_preview && npx serve site_preview -l 8001` for a quick local check.
Samira: can reviewers push a quick local check? i'm worried about approving while previews are stale.
Jen: is there a small checklist for reviewers? i can spin up a local nginx container but prefer a one-liner.
Alex R: yep — checklist I used:
1) mkdocs build -d site_preview
2) python -m http.server 8002 --directory site_preview
3) open http://localhost:8002/authentication/ and check snippet rendering and the rust code block copy button
Example commands:
```
pipx run mkdocs build -d site_preview
python -m http.server 8002 --directory site_preview
```
Tess: nice. also FYI if you hit the asset 404, run `mkdocs build --clean` to clear stale files.
docs-ci: Build report: preview build queued (Netlify). Status: queued; estimated wait ~15m. Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/4128
Devon: alternative — if you need a fast hosted preview, i can push a temporary vercel preview (works for small site). ping me and I'll deploy from the PR branch.
Alex R: that would help. if queue >20m let's do it. @Devon can you deploy and paste the link here?
Devon: done — https://pr-4128-docs.vercel.app — fonts/rendering look ok. please review.
Samira: looks good to me, snippets copy successfully. one tiny nit: auth.rst -> code example missing semicolon in node snippet.
Alex R: fixed in a follow-up commit. thanks!
Jen: are we okay to merge now? any CI blockers?
docs-ci: Final status: unit docs checks passed; preview still pending on Netlify but vercel preview available. No blocking regressions.
Alex R: i’ll merge in the next merge slot (13:00 UTC) to avoid the heavy morning netlify queue. thanks everyone — appreciate the quick reviews :rocket:
deploy-bot: heads-up: scheduled merge at 1732102800 will trigger a docs rebuild across dedicated workers.
